title: Synthetic Benchmark Metadata for Low-FPR Collusion Detection
abstract: Synthetic fixture metadata: a graph collusion detector is evaluated with aggregate false-positive rates but not operator workload at fixed alert budgets.

title: Synthetic Deployment Audit Notes for Collusion Monitors
abstract: Synthetic fixture metadata: deployment-shift audits are discussed, but calibrated low-FPR triage under changing base rates remains unresolved.
